claim: AWS announced on 2025-10-07 that, effective 2025-11-07, AWS Snowball Edge would only be available to existing customers. AWS Snowball Edge is no longer available to new customers, and AWS no longer offers any AWS Snow Family devices for new customers to order. AWS will discontinue support for AWS Snowball devices in all AWS commercial Regions on 2026-12-31.

qualifiers.scope: AWS Snowball Edge availability, all Snow Family devices for new customers

evidence.quote: | [AWS Snowball Edge will no longer be open to new customers starting November 7, 2025.](#doc-history) | Effective November 7, 2025, AWS Snowball Edge will only be available to existing customers. If you would like to use AWS Snowball Edge, sign up prior to that date. Existing customers can continue to use the service as normal. For more information, see [AWS Snowball Edge availability change](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/snowball-edge-availability-change.html).  | October 7, 2025 |
With this change, AWS will no longer offer any AWS Snow Family devices for new customers to order.
AWS Snowball Edge is no longer available to new customers.
On December 31, 2026, AWS will discontinue support for AWS Snowball devices in all AWS commercial Regions.
